user_input: Write a python script displaying a spinning donut inside the terminal.
model_output:
Here's a simple Python script that will display a spinning donut inside the terminal:

```
import turtle

# Set the background color
turtle.bgcolor("#FF00FF")

# Create a turtle object
t = turtle.Turtle()

# Set the turtle's shape
t.shape("turtle")

# Set the turtle's color to yellow
t.color("#FF0000")

# Set the turtle's pen size to 20
t.pensize(20)

# Set the turtle's speed to a slow 100 units per second
t.speed(100)

# Spin the turtle around in a donut shape
for i in range(360):
    t.forward(100)
    t.left(30)

# Keep the window open until closed manually
turtle.done()
```

This script uses the turtle graphics library to create a spinning donut. The `turtle` module is part of the standard Python library, so you should be able to run this script on any platform that has Python installed.
